mapper.insert: insert into system_notice (title, content, publisher_id, type) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{publisherId}, #{type})
mapper.select: select id, title, content, publisher_id as publisherId, publish_time as publishTime, type from system_notice where publisher_id = #{publisherId} order by id desc

select n.id, n.title, n.content, n.publisher_id as publisherId, n.publisher_id as userId, u.real_name as publisherRealName, n.publish_time as publishTime, n.type from system_notice n left join user u on n.publisher_id = u.id where n.id = #{id}
